executions.name: Donor Card
executions.script: One open hand, and the skeleton answers — walking them forward one marionette step at a time until it simply steps out and stands beside her like a new recruit. She catalogs it on a wrist-slate.

executions.name: Iron Maiden
executions.script: A gentle push on the sternum, and every bone blooms outward at once in a perfect symmetrical lattice. She circles it once. "Load-bearing. Good bones."

desecration.name: Restock
desecration.script: The final spear pins them to her Reliquary Wall; she is already walking over to collect her ammunition.

overdrive.name: CATHEDRAL
overdrive.script: A ribvault of colossal bone grows around the opponent and closes like a fist. It crumbles to reveal them crumpled in a rose window of their own blood.
